'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Paul Bansal LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bansal]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)|VB4-L-watchyourstep-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Battle at the O.K. Corellian
* '''Username:''' DarkBro
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
